name: Fixture Shell Contention
description: Two practices of one method contribute sequential stages to the same baseline-published shell and both take the same position. Neither is a dependency of the other, so nothing but the method sees the clash.

practices.name: Fixture Shell Contributor A
practices.description: Contributes the first phase of the adoption endeavour the baseline published as a shell.

patternViews.name: Make It Usable

practices.name: Fixture Shell Contributor B
practices.description: Contributes a later phase of the same shell, unaware that a sibling has already taken the position.
